description: Banned failure signatures — chart bot must not repeat these draw mistakes.

signatures.rule: Do not place C1–C3 on a left-side dump when a later progressive base exists under the pivot.
When a late (right-side) VCP base exists, never label Jan/Feb micro-swings as C1–C3.
VCP export must include C1/C2/C3 + green vol-dry box + DTL + pivot point labels.
